messages:
siena: Heads up — after bringing up magnet16k-int4 on staging I see context divergence for very long prefill sessions (>48k tokens). Repro noisy but consistent on seed 42.

siena: Symptom: generated tokens diverge mid-stream when a repeated anchor appears near ~50k. Suspect off-by-one in RoPE index mapping or quant packing.

vikram: paste minimal repro and commit?

siena: commit a1c9f3d (onnx int4 pass). Run: ./run_infer --model magnet16k_int4.onnx --prefill-file long_prefill.txt --max-tokens 62000 --batch 1

siena: logs:
[2026-03-17 14:02:11] kv_store: prefill step 49120: write_idx=49120 shard=2
[2026-03-17 14:02:11] attn: rotary_idx=49120 scale=1.00003
[2026-03-17 14:02:11] kv_store: get_idx returned 49119 for query 49120
[2026-03-17 14:02:12] gen: output token mismatch at pos 50403 expected="the" got="a"

luka: get_idx off by one on KV read. attach kvcache_dump for 49000..50500.

oliver: int4 packing switched to nibble packing + reshape; could be alignment/memcpy.

siena: FP16 and int8 builds -> no divergence. int4 new -> reproduces.

vikram: plan: add assert hooks in kvcache read/write, run single-shard deterministic, bisect quant pass. I'll do asserts + single-shard. @siena reduced prefill please.

siena: reduced prefill 32k with anchor at 31k/62k -> still repro. Uploading reduced_prefill_31k.txt and kvtrace.

vikram: running assert build. Command: BUILD_TAG=kv-assert-20260317 bazel build //runtime:inference --config=int4-assert && ./bazel-bin/runtime/inference --model magnet16k_int4.onnx --prefill reduced_prefill_31k.txt --verbose-kvcache --dump-kv=kvtrace.json

luka: assert: when reading KV index i, verify stored_key_pos[layer][i]==i and log +/-8 if mismatch.

vikram: failure observed: read_idx 31017 returned key_pos 31016 on shard 1 layer 8. Snapshot shows one-off at nibble boundary crossing 64-bit word.

oliver: confirms packing alignment bug — likely copy/fence issue or partial-byte write.

siena: mitigation for staging? revert int4 nibble reshape patch?

vikram: reverting a1c9f3d -> a1c9f3c on staging now.

qa-bot: canary: 0/5 reproductions after revert. seed 42 no longer reproduces.

oliver: follow-ups: add unit test for nibble-boundary copy, add fuzz for windows near 8/16/64 boundaries, and metric kv_index_mismatch_count for prod alerting.

siena: filing PR with reduced repro + test + kvtrace. Thanks all.

vikram: good catch. tagging for rolling notes. :thumbsup:
